description: Records that an identity was deleted (PROJE-KAYDI.md O-27). It keeps no raw identity: only the HMAC-SHA256 digest of the issuer and subject pair. Provisioning, enabling and e-mail changes check this record first, so a deleted identity cannot come back.

fields.description: HMAC-SHA256 digest of the issuer and subject pair, as 64 hexadecimal characters. The key is the site setting kimlik_deletion_hmac_key. The raw pair is not stored.
fields.label: Identity Hash

fields.description: Disabled: step 1 closed the account, its sessions and API keys. Anonymized: step 2 removed the personal data.
fields.label: State

fields.description: Current name of the Frappe user. It is the anonymous name after step 2.
fields.label: User

name: Platform Identity Deletion
